column1: # Tag audit proposals — pilot batch, every 8th flag by code (32 of 254). See #174.
# HOW TO REVIEW: delete the rows you disagree with. What survives is applied.
# Nothing else to fill in; the deletions are themselves the record of your call.
# Then say so, and the agent runs scripts/apply-tag-audit.mjs, the validators and
# the Playwright suite. Do not edit proposals.original.tsv — the difference
# between it and this file is how your rejections get remembered.
# The code column is ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; look one up at
# Columns: code, tag, add|remove, confidence, why.

column5: The arms are a quartered heraldic shield.

The motto sits on a banderole under the shield.
The band of stars is white; no white is tagged.
The green band at the hoist is vertical, crossing the two horizontals.
The red band down the centre is vertical, crossing the four horizontals.
The red band at the hoist is vertical, crossing the two horizontals.
The eagle of Saladin carries an escutcheon on its breast.
The country name sits on a scroll below the eagle.
The ring around the star is a lei of flowers and leaves.
The emblem is a triangle containing the volcanoes.
The triangle sits inside a lettered ring.
The canton is the Union Jack, a flag within the flag.
The arms are on a shield, below a crest.
Water runs beneath the cactus, the same feature tagged waves on es.
